cone_plane_display.density: Saved angular_backprojection_per_rad, linear colour scale; no new smoothing or optimizer.
cone_plane_display.overlay_weighting: Opacity=0.58*original candidate prior; no per-event renormalization.

independent_diagnostic_envelope.scope: Maximum on saved fixed independent diagnostic injections; not a confidence level.

limitations: Simulation-derived independent injections, not laboratory calibration.
Only the selected X/Y injection signals were saved; induction on other strips is not modelled.
Charge pixels are not necessarily separate photon interactions: electron paths and charge sharing can span strips.
The sparse energy-flow hypotheses do not exhaust continuous N:N energy allocations, subthreshold pixels, or same-pixel multiplicity.
Profile depth intervals are deterministic calibration-discrepancy sets, not confidence intervals.
Cones are conditional on one fully absorbed photon; cascade, escape and background alternatives remain unresolved.
pooling: All four independent acquisitions; anonymous, no equalization or simultaneous pileup.

posthoc_evaluation.angular_metrics_unavailable_reason: Saved153evaluation has no source-angle residuals; legacy unkeyed angle arrays lack a bound candidate-order witness.
interpretation: Charge cells are not necessarily photon vertices. Strict birth-order unknowns are retained.
Candidate-weight changes do not change the saved geometry, errors, hypotheses or labels.
posthoc_evaluation.residual_definition: Saved reconstructed-minus-deposition-centroid XYZ/energy residuals; photon-birth vertex residuals only where the original strict reference was defined. Values and strict birth-order labels are unchanged.
posthoc_evaluation.scope: Same-event posthoc reuse of the existing153-group metadata evaluation. Not a new untouched holdout; no truth enters selection, fitting or imaging.
posthoc_evaluation.weighting: Corrected original candidate priors without renormalization. For saved spatial residuals, sum candidate prior per hypothesis and divide that mass equally among its known sites; unknown vertices remain excluded with known mass explicit. These weights are engineering priors, not calibrated posteriors.

source_composition: Two real nuclides (Cs137/Co60) plus two662keVmonoenergetic controls at two positions.
